inventory_notes: Inventoried by file-system scan of src/components/calculators/ (60 .tsx) and src/pages/ (132 .astro). Component-level formulas inspected by subagent review; full manual verification of every formula requires dedicated test pass.
verified_status: NOT FULLY VERIFIED — Component files read; individual formula accuracy (e.g., BMI = kg/m2, EMI annuity formula) confirmed against standard references for top calculators only. Remaining 50+ components not individually tested.
key_defects_found: No centralized unit-test file for calculators; no test framework configured besides Astro build.
Potential division-by-zero in compound-interest if rate=0; not explicitly guarded in all components.
CurrencyConverter relies on external rate source (not verified live in audit).
Embedding pages (/embed/) mirror calculators and are noindexed (intended).
Programmatic pSEO pages (mortgage/[country], emi/[bank]) rely on static data files (mortgage-locales.ts, emi-banks.ts) — data freshness unverified.

seo_implementation.sitemap: astro.config.mjs generates sitemap with filter exclusions (bank-state, city-bank, embed widgets, /legal/); priorities 0.4-1.0; changefreq weekly/monthly.
seo_implementation.robots: public/robots.txt allows all bots + explicit AI bot allow (GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, etc.); Sitemap declared.
seo_implementation.structured_data: BaseLayout.astro emits WebApplication + BreadcrumbList + FAQPage + Organization + Website + HowTo + Speakable; calculator pages pass meta via props.
seo_implementation.canonical: BaseLayout constructs canonical from Astro.url.pathname + SITE.url; trailing-slash consistent.
seo_implementation.meta: Title trimmed to 60 visible chars; description to 155 chars; OpenGraph + Twitter cards + favicon suite.
seo_implementation.indexnow: scripts/ping-indexnow.js submits sitemap to IndexNow post-build.
seo_implementation.consent: Google Consent Mode v2 (region-scoped default deny for EEA/UK/CH) in BaseLayout.
seo_implementation.analytics: GTM + GA4 deferred load; no tracking before consent for EU region.

hosting_readiness.recommended_platform: Cloudflare Pages (free tier) — already configured via .github/workflows/deploy.yml and functions/_middleware.ts (geo-redirect + bot bypass)
hosting_readiness.serverless_edge: Cloudflare Pages Functions (functions/_middleware.ts) handles geo-redirect and bot bypass without full backend
